data.body: Resumed after a cancelled session. Implementation complete in worktree fix-23b2: completion_expectation (8-value present-only enum) stamped by txn._stamp_close_metadata on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write (close_class/force_close_reason precedent), computed as the second half of _completion_precheck's returned pair (consumes the GateState tri-state; gate state resolves first, so force under disabled/unreadable records gate_off/gate_unreadable), not_applicable set on the idea->closed path in close_ticket, folded by _fold_close_metadata on the winning edge, declared in common/ticket_state schemas + types.py, documented in docs/event-schema.md §'Close metadata on the *->closed STATUS event'. All 9 ACs have tests (incl. single-lock counting monkeypatch, three-way signed/lost/gate-off separation, and legacy-event replay with the key ABSENT). lint + typecheck + complexity ratchet green (new=0 increased=0; 2 stale = allowed improvements). Full unit suite: 11653 passed; the 5 failures in test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout are pre-existing/environmental (fail identically on untouched main — host safe.bareRepository interplay), unrelated to this change. Pushed as Gerrit change 2042 (Change-Id Iae93958ef88749188728a066cd9f5bacde15a1f8); awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
